referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A suburban-home photo carries the firm introduction while a conspicuous three-part phone and quote ribbon occupies the lower hero edge. Blue service link line and a bright quote control above the hero, with contact routes visible early. Direct sans headings in saturated blue, slim body paragraphs and red underline/CTA accents. The page sequence runs from house-photo opening to phone-and-quote ribbon to service two-by-two image grid toward customer quote chapter, service-area map, blue contact footer. Technician action photos form a two-by-two service grid; family/team, financing, testimonials and mapped service area follow. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.
